paper.title_en: Sato-theoretic construction of the anti-self-dual Yang-Mills hierarchy and the Ward conjecture
paper.abstract_en: We develop the Sato-theoretic dressing framework for the anti-self-dual Yang-Mills (ASDYM) hierarchy based on a normalized Riemann-Hilbert decomposition. A four-sector expansion of the generating function yields a bi-infinite matrix array of relative coordinates, extending the affine coordinates on the big cell of the Sato Grassmannian. We derive the Sato-Wilson equations, continuous coordinate flows, and their discrete analogues. Several classical integrable hierarchies are recovered under dimensional reduction constraints, with their nonlinear variables identified as specific relative coordinates.
